svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Number with a drug use disorder by substance World
Total number of people with a drug use disorder, differentiated by drug/substance type. Drug dependence is
defined by the International Classification of Diseases as the presence of three or more indicators of
dependence for at least a month within the previous year.
